record.question: The percentage of the incoming radiation reflected back to space by the earth is -
record.explanation: About 30% of incoming sunlight is reflected to space by Earth’s surface, atmosphere and clouds together. It is an approximate planetary average (albedo), not a fixed value for every surface. Reference: https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/clouds-and-radiation/. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
